maria: quick follow-up from last night's KV eviction spike. need concrete owners for regression + drills so remediation sticks.

sam: Agreed. propose: replay/regression infra, promptset eval, weekly canary cron, and a chaos drill.

lee: I'll own replay/regression infra. target smoke by Thu, full run next Wed. will push k6 script under infra/tests/kv_replay.

jordan: I'll curate a focused promptset (kv_prefix_misroute) and add eval checks. draft by Fri EOD.

anya: I can run the chaos drill Mon 03:00 PT and be oncall. sam you good to rotate?
sam: yes, i'll rotate and add the weekly cron that fails canary if eviction regression >3%.

ci-bot: Created RED-4642 (kv-replay-regression) assigned lee due: 2026-04-01; RED-4643 (kv-prompt-eval) assigned jordan due: 2026-03-27.

maria: Action summary: 1) replay/regression (lee) 2) promptset+eval (jordan) 3) chaos drill (anya/sam) 4) weekly canary gate (sam) 5) eviction alert threshold (jordan+ops). Please add owners/due dates to tickets and ping here when set.
